news_items.headline: Howmet Aerospace Reports First Quarter 2026 Results
news_items.summary: Q1 2026 revenue $2.31B (+19% YoY, 3.2% beat); non-GAAP EPS $1.22 (10.3% beat); adjusted EBITDA margin expanded 320bps YoY to 32.0%.

news_items.headline: Howmet surges after Q1 beat, raises outlook on aerospace demand
news_items.summary: Company raised FY 2026 revenue guidance to $9.65B midpoint (from $9.1B, +6%) and adjusted EPS guidance to $4.94 midpoint (+11%) on commercial and defense aerospace demand.

news_items.headline: Howmet (HWM) Shares Skyrocket - What You Need To Know
news_items.summary: HWM shares jumped 10.8% intraday after the Q1 beat-and-raise; stock climbed to $276.16 with intraday peak at $290.

news_items.headline: Howmet Aerospace Stock Hits 52-Week High; CEO warns Iran conflict could hit demand momentum
news_items.summary: Stock hit 52-week high after Q1 earnings; CEO publicly cautioned that an Iran conflict could disrupt aerospace demand momentum despite raised outlook.

news_items.headline: How Strong Earnings, Raised Guidance, and Higher Payouts Will Impact Howmet Aerospace Investors
news_items.summary: Free cash flow rose to $359M in Q1 (from $134M YoY); company bought back $300M of shares in Q1 plus an additional $150M in April.

news_items.headline: Howmet Aerospace Stock Jumps: HWM Raises 2026 Forecast as Jet Demand Powers Profit Beat
news_items.summary: Engine products were the largest contributor to revenue growth; F-35 program orders and gas turbine markets cited as key tailwinds.

news_items.headline: Howmet Aerospace Updates Q2 2026 Earnings Guidance
news_items.summary: Company issued updated Q2 2026 forward guidance alongside the Q1 release, in line with raised full-year outlook.
